description:
FOUND (s526w1, Data-Dumper t/dumper.t rows 199/201 "vstrings": got `$a = bless( do{\(my $o = v65.66.67)}, 'VSTRING' );`, expected `$a = \v65.66.67;`).
Probe (scratch p-ddmisc.pl): my $v = \v65.66.67; print ref($v), reftype($v), defined blessed($v), overload::StrVal($v)
perl 5.40.3: VSTRING VSTRING unblessed VSTRING(0x..).   PCL: VSTRING SCALAR blessed VSTRING(0x..).
Data::Dumper's PP _dump asks Scalar::Util::blessed first, so the ref is dumped as an object.  Related: #1495 (ref.t "stringify for ref to vstring").  Rows: Data-Dumper dumper.t 199, 201.  Layer: runtime (the VSTRING referent kind: blessed / reftype).
subject: A reference to a V-STRING is BLESSED into "VSTRING" with reftype SCALAR in PCL -- perl: unblessed, ref and reftype both VSTRING; Data::Dumper dumps \v65.66.67 as bless( do{\(my $o = v65.66.67)}, 'VSTRING' )
